question.prompt: Last year Mr. John Q. Public received an inheritance. He paid \(20\%\) in federal taxes on the inheritance, and paid \(10\%\) of what he had left in state taxes. He paid a total of \(\$10{,}500\) for both taxes. How many dollars was the inheritance?

solutions.explanation:
After paying the federal tax, Mr. Public had \(100\%-20\%=80\%\) of the inheritance left. The state tax was \(10\%\) of that remaining amount, so it was
\[
0.10\cdot0.80=0.08=8\%
\]
of the original inheritance. Together, the taxes were \(20\%+8\%=28\%\) of the inheritance.

Since this \(28\%\) amounted to \(\$10{,}500\), the whole inheritance was
\[
10{,}500\div0.28=37{,}500.
\]
Indeed, the federal tax was \(\$7{,}500\), leaving \(\$30{,}000\); the state tax was then \(\$3{,}000\), giving the required total tax. The inheritance was \(\boxed{\$37{,}500}\), choice D.
solutions.title: Find the total tax percentage
